description: Recall why fixed-size transcript tails failed and the bounded recovery design.

setup_messages.prompt: Remember this failure: reading only the final 64 KiB of an agent JSONL transcript can begin inside an oversized tool-result record. Dropping that partial line may leave no conversation to capture. The selected fix starts at 64 KiB and expands backward up to 4 MiB until complete conversational messages are found, while retaining only six extracted messages and excluding tool-result blocks.

continuation_prompt: A real agent Stop hook returns an empty object and creates no memory after a session with a very large tool result. Diagnose the likely transcript parsing failure and describe the bounded fix we selected.

expected_facts.description: A fixed tail can start inside a large JSONL record and discard useful context.
Expand the scan from 64 KiB up to 4 MiB until messages are found.
Only six useful conversation messages are retained.

forbidden_facts.description: The fix must not ingest an unbounded complete transcript.
match_any: read the entire transcript without a limit
